core_obligations: Part (1): preimages of affine opens are affine, from the glueing description of the relative spectrum.
Part (2): the fibre product identification for every base change, from the spec-base-change card.
Part (3): the universal map A to pi_* O is an isomorphism of algebras; the assertion is local on S, and over an affine base it is the affine-case identification.
